_about: The demand growth explorer (/explore/demand-growth): the page's own code drawn on the rows of eia930_demand_growth (site/scripts/demand-growth-figures.mjs) beside the replication (replication/demand_growth/replicate.py). Held here: every slot of the page as it opens, and the three headline numbers of each of the 312 views; the run itself compares every slot of every view.
line: /explore/demand-growth: 35936 of 35936 slots of text on 315 views equal the replication's (3275 distinct checked figures; 770 of 770 growth figures recomputed from the MW rows)
